journeys.name: Full Happy Path Lifecycle — Registration to Post-Approval Login

steps.action: Guest submits complete valid registration
Admin opens Advanced B2B/B2C > Registration Applications, sees full submitted wholesale data for the applicant
Admin checks Active flag, saves

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Single customer entity carried through registration -> admin review -> admin approval; later journeys (J-09 uses its own account, J-10 depends on this one completing) share this state.

journeys.name: Valid Input Variants — Alternate Business Type & Contact Media

steps.action: Submit with alternate Type of Business + Contact Media = Messenger
Submit with all Company Info fields validly filled across multiple business types
Select Contact Media = WhatsApp, verify field reveal, submit
Select Contact Media = Messenger, verify field reveal, submit
Submit with all Account Setup fields validly filled
Submit with all 4 agreements checked

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Each scenario uses its own namespaced synthetic account; no shared state mutated.

journeys.name: Required-Field & Format Validation (Data-Driven Negative Scenarios)

steps.action: Submit with Company Name blank
Submit with malformed Email
Submit with Password != Confirm Password
Submit with empty Password
Submit with Terms of Service unchecked

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: No entity is ever created (all rejected before backend persistence) — nothing to namespace-collide on.

journeys.name: Boundary & Edge Data Handling

steps.action: Submit with 10-digit, 11-digit, 12-digit phone numbers
Submit Company Name with Unicode/special characters
Submit Zip Code empty vs whitespace-only
Submit Username with special characters/spaces
Submit with only 18+ confirmation unchecked

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Each boundary case uses its own namespaced data; the only successful sub-case (valid 11-digit phone) creates its own isolated entity.

journeys.name: Contact Media Dynamic Toggle Behavior

steps.action: Select WhatsApp, fill number, switch to Messenger, fill Messenger fields, submit
Select WhatsApp, leave number blank, submit

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Isolated form-interaction scenarios, own namespaced data.

journeys.name: Uniqueness Validation (Duplicate Email/Username)

steps.action: Submit with brand-new unique email/username
Submit with Email = userKBD@gmail.com (known existing)
Submit with a known-existing Username
Submit with case-variant of userKBD@gmail.com

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Reads against a fixed known account (userKBD@gmail.com) — safe to run parallel to other features, but keep serial within this feature to avoid racing the one TC-022 entity creation against duplicate-check reads.

steps.action: Fill valid form, double-click Create Account rapidly

journeys.name: Admin Visibility — Registration Applications No-Match State

steps.action: Admin searches Registration Applications for a non-matching email/name
steps.transition: S2 -> S2 (no crash, empty grid state)

journeys.name: Pre-Approval Login Block

steps.action: Register a fresh account, then immediately attempt login before any admin action

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Uses its own dedicated fresh registration rather than sharing J-01's account, to avoid ordering coupling with the approval step.

journeys.name: Post-Approval Deactivation

steps.action: Admin unchecks Active on J-01's now-active account, saves, attempt login

journeys.parallelSafetyReason: Must run after J-01 completes — depends on J-01's account already being active.

asyncHandlers.strategy: Poll admin customer grid, check Active status
Not directly testable E2E without a mail server; flag as limitation unless the app surfaces an observable in-app signal
